=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27675-27754 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In recover_stalled_issue, the open-linked-PR sub-cases call `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` at lines 27687 (dirty PR, conflict resolver) and 27715 (CHANGES_REQUESTED autofix), then return at 27693 / 27699 / 27721 / 27727. The new queue backpressure guard at lines 27747-27754 / 27751 is never reached on these paths.
  WHY: `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` (28201-28259) checks only the cycle-local tracker (28219) and `_has_active_autofix_run` (28229) and never checks queue backpressure. So when ACTIONS_QUEUED_TOTAL >= ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_HIGH (default 150), review_autofix runs keep landing in the jammed queue and no `QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE outcome=held` line is logged. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26420-26499 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In run_standalone_stall_recovery, the merge-conflict path calls `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts "${STALL_CONFLICT_PR_NUM}" "${STALL_CONFLICT_HEAD_REF}"` at line 26422 and then hits `continue` at 26443, before the new guard at lines 26496-26499.
  WHY: Stalled issues with merge conflicts still send the conflict resolver into a jammed queue with no backpressure hold, and the dispatch also bumps `conflict_override_count` (line 26426). This contradicts issue scope item 3 and the agents.d fragment's claim that the hold "covers stall-recovery re-dispatch". All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18218-18475 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_load_actions_runs_cached` resets ACTIONS_QUEUED_TOTAL='' at line 18218. The memory-cache path (18256-18261) and the 304 reuse path (18313-18336) then return before the queued read (18345-18357), so `queue_backpressure_holds_dispatch` takes the unknown-depth branch (18467-18475) and allows the dispatch.
  WHY: If-None-Match is sent only on the status=in_progress listing, so a 304 is most likely exactly when runners are jammed and the in-progress set is frozen. The hold is then off on the ticks where it is needed. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (a documented limitation that cannot be fixed within files_touched); the other three rated it MAJOR, and the highest was used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20616-20623, 26492-26499, 27747-27754 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: One queue-backpressure hold produces two STALL_SKIP reason tokens. Capped actions held inside phase_cap_can_dispatch log reason=phase_capped, while uncapped actions held by queue_backpressure_holds_uncapped_stall_action log reason=queue_backpressure.
  WHY: Counters, alerts and log queries keyed on reason=phase_capped count queue-backpressure holds as phase-cap hits, and the two cases cannot be told apart from the STALL_SKIP line alone.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The only new guards are at lines 20620, 26496 and 27751, and all three run after the dispatch sites at 27687, 27715 and 26422; the open-linked-PR sites return 0 at 27693 and 27721 before reaching any guard, `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` (28201-28259) contains no queue-backpressure check, neither the PR diff nor the last-run diff adds a queue_backpressure call on these early paths, and the dispatch_rb_judge path at 28432 is the only uncapped path that goes through phase_cap_can_dispatch.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:recover_stalled_issue 27675-27728 (dispatch at 27687, 27715; guard at 27747-27754); run_standalone_stall_recovery 26422 → continue 26443, guard 26496-26499 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The conflict-resolver and changes-requested autofix dispatches return or continue before the new queue_backpressure_holds_uncapped_stall_action guards are reached. `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` (line 28201) has no backpressure check of its own.
  WHY: At ACTIONS_QUEUED_TOTAL=300 with HIGH=150, review_autofix runs are still dispatched with no QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE held line, and the standalone path also bumps conflict_override_count (26426). The close_and_reissue path at 27682 is covered via the guard at 20620. Suggested fix: a queue_backpressure_holds_dispatch check before 27686, 27714 and 26421, then update test_stall_guards_hold_uncapped_actions.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_load_actions_runs_cached 18218, 18256-18261, 18313-18335, 18345-18354, 18467-18475 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The TTL and 304 returns skip the queued read, so ACTIONS_QUEUED_TOTAL stays empty and every dispatch is allowed with outcome=unknown.
  WHY: A 304 is likely when runners are starved, so a queue of 300 is treated as unknown. A proper fix needs an orchestrate_poll.yml marker or a scripts/ai_memory.py change, both outside the grant; the reviewer recommends recording it as a known residual in the PR body.

  Evidence of absence: The only new stall guards are at 20620, 26496 and 27751, and all run after the early dispatch-and-return/continue paths.

- Not reported as gaps (3 related items): hysteresis (ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_LOW) and the marker file both need `orchestrate_poll.yml`, which the issue forbids; the clarify-respond wrapper run-name is outside the six-file list and the grant; Phase 3 steps 10-13 need `scripts/persist_budget.py`, which is outside the grant.

  Issue: conflict-resolver and autofix stall dispatches bypass the backpressure hold.
  Fix: queue_backpressure_holds_dispatch guard (`continue` in the standalone loop), plus an update to tests/test_poll_issue_run_linkage.py::test_stall_guards_hold_uncapped_actions; ~12 lines.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh queue_backpressure_holds_uncapped_stall_action (lines 18503-18511)
  Issue: the helper is default-allow, so a future uncapped action would escape the hold.
  Fix: invert the case so that `run_stall_judge|attempt_merge|escalate_human|skip` return 1 and every other action is held; ~5 lines.
